text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle watches on TV as Silence<n>Suzuka
faces off against<n>Matikanefukukitaru in her first
race<n>after returning from Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka takes first place by a margin<n>of over ten
lengths, captivating the<n>hearts of the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Elated to see her friend win, Taiki<n>Shuttle cheers
and kicks off a party in<n>celebration.
